Date April 12, 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. No. D 4762）

Subject (in full) Kurt Gerhardt Gurski.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special
Branch of March 31, 1933 on the subject of K. Gurski who in
December 1931 was living in No.7A Cathay Flats, enquiries show
that Kurt Gerhardt Gurski is a German and born on September 18,
1904 at Braunshweig, but it is not known whether he is a
Braunshweig or Prussian citizen. He holds a passport issued by
Hamburg Police on 27.10.23. On February ..., 1929 he married to
one Golda Fishman, Russian Jewess born on February 7, 1911 at
Harbin. On February 1, 1924 K. Gurski registered first with
the local German Consulate General. It is known that since
1924 he was employed with "Sapt" Textile Products, Ltd.
(Exporters and Importers of Raw Cotton and Cotton Waste), 16A
Kiukieng Road. The head office of this firm is at Zurich,
Switzerland with also a branch reported to be in Stuttgart,
Germany. Recently Gurski left this firm and it is stated that he
intends to establish his own business (Import of Textile-
machinery, technical articles, machinery). From October 1930
to February 1932 Gurski resided at Flat 7A Cathay Flats, Avenue
Joffre. His present residence is 573 Rue de Sieyes
(Tel. 73883).

It is reported that K. Gurski recently applied for member-
ship at the local branch of "Nazi" (National Socialist Party)
but his request was refused. It is believed that the reason is
that he is married to a Jewess and his political views at present
are not clear.

日期：1933年4月12日。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处中央特别科档案室。档案号 D 4762）

事由（全称）库尔特·格哈特·古尔斯基（Kurt Gerhardt Gurski）。

制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）。呈报人：[签名]

关于1933年3月31日特别科主管警官就 K. 古尔斯基一事所发备忘录，经查，K. 古尔斯基于1931年12月居住于华懋公寓7A号。调查显示，库尔特·格哈特·古尔斯基系德国人，1904年9月18日出生于布伦瑞克（Braunshweig），但其究竟是布伦瑞克公民还是普鲁士公民，目前尚不清楚。他持有汉堡警方于1923年10月27日签发的护照。1929年2月……日，他与戈尔达·费什曼（Golda Fishman）结婚，后者系俄籍犹太人，1911年2月7日出生于哈尔滨。1924年2月1日，K. 古尔斯基首次向当地德国总领事馆登记。据悉，自1924年起，他受雇于“萨普特”纺织产品有限公司（“Sapt” Textile Products, Ltd.，原棉及棉废料的进出口商），地址为九江路16A号。该公司总部设在瑞士苏黎世，另有消息称其在德国斯图加特设有分公司。近期，古尔斯基已离开该公司，据称他打算自立门户经营业务（进口纺织机械、技术用品及机械设备）。1930年10月至1932年2月期间，古尔斯基居住在霞飞路华懋公寓7A室。其现住址为西爱咸斯路573号（电话：73883）。

据报，K. 古尔斯基最近申请加入当地“纳粹”（国家社会主义党）支部，但遭拒绝。相信原因是其妻子为犹太人，且其目前的政治观点尚不明确。
